text: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Brisbane for operational reporting and data warehousing?

items.markdown:
Agile Insights[Agile Insights](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/fabric-insights/) and TechnologyCue[TechnologyCue](https://technologycue.com.au/) are prominent specialized providers for Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consulting servicing the Brisbane market, alongside major national enterprise Microsoft partners with local Queensland practices (such as Data#3, Avanade, and Empired/Crayon).[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/)[[2]](https://technologycue.com.au/microsoft-bi-services-brisbane/)

### Top Microsoft Analytics & Data Warehousing Consultants in Brisbane

| Firm / Consultant | Core Focus Areas | Key Offerings & Capabilities |
|---|---|---|
| Agile Insights[Agile Insights](https://www.agileinsights.com/) | Governed Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Analytics | • End-to-end Microsoft Fabric & OneLake data platforms

• Enterprise security, Row-Level Security (RLS) & compliance  
• Managed BI services and staff augmentation |

### Key Specialisations for Operational Reporting & Data Warehousing

When evaluating a consultant for operational reporting and data warehousing in the **Microsoft Fabric** and **Power BI** ecosystem, look for experience in:

- **Direct Lake & Golden Models:** Designing high-performance semantic models that query large data volumes in Microsoft Fabric's OneLake without traditional import/DirectQuery bottlenecks.[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/)
- **Operational Reporting Pipelines:** Building near-real-time eventstreams, automated alerts (via Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence / Activator), and operational shift or floor dashboards.[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/)
- **Data Governance & Lineage:** Implementing Microsoft Purview, sensitivity labels, workspace deployment pipelines, and strict Row-Level Security (RLS) so operational business units trust the numbers.[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/)

If you can share your **industry**, **current data source** (e.g., SQL Server, SAP, Salesforce), or whether you are **migrating to Microsoft Fabric** from scratch, I can help tailor what capabilities or questions to ask these consultants.
